snippet.title: Cubic Color Confusion - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4759190

Cubic Color Confusion is a grid-based puzzle game where every move changes the world. Manipulate the environment and guide your cubes through ever more intricate puzzles to recover valuable artefacts from the ruins of a lost civilization. Can you master every challenge?

A playable Demo is available now!
